description.value: Free cable ferry operated by WaterBridge Ferries Inc. under contract to the BC Ministry of Transportation and Transit, linking Fauquier and Needles across Lower Arrow Lake on Highway 6. Crossing takes about 5 minutes; sailings run every 30 minutes from 5 am to 10 pm, with on-demand service overnight, no reservation needed. BC's Ministry of Transportation and Transit treats all inland ferries as an extension of the provincial highway system, mandated to accommodate all legal road users, including cyclists — bikes and e-bikes both ride free and unboxed.
